statement: Owner-guided wired controls produced complete mouse report 0x40 (6 wire bytes) and keyboard report 0x41 (9 wire bytes). Right-pad movement maps to relative X and inverted Y; right-pad click and the native right-trigger button bit map to mouse Button 1, and the native left-trigger button bit maps to Button 2. Left-pad movement maps to horizontal Consumer usage 0x0238 and inverted vertical wheel fields. A maps to keyboard usage 0x28, B and Options/Menu to 0x29, View to 0x2b, and D-pad Up/Down/Left/Right to 0x52/0x51/0x50/0x4f. Each prompted keyboard press has a release. Stick travel/touch, pad touch alone, left-pad click, X/Y, shoulders, stick clicks, QAM, rear buttons, Steam and grip touch produced no desktop reports in their labelled windows; native input confirmed actions. Full-trigger held-button reports repeated approximately every 4 ms, so pure wire-change-only emission is not established. Absence is bounded to these windows.

applicability.firmware: Not independently re-read in each action session; no firmware update performed
applicability.scope: Bounded owner-guided windows and normal SDL open/close only; no wireless, watchdog or calibrated transfer function.
